subject: Habit Opco Methadone Clinic Permit Withdrawal
overview: The City Council announced that Habit Opco has rescinded its special permit application for a methadone clinic on Salem Street following significant community opposition. Residents and officials expressed concerns regarding the proposed facility's proximity to a local elementary school and residential areas.

items.title: Habit Opco Special Permit Withdrawal
items.summary: Habit Opco rescinded its request for a special permit to operate a methadone clinic on Salem Street after neighbors protested the location's proximity to schools and parks. The company indicated in a letter that it will continue to work with the city to find a more appropriate location for the facility.
